hansard.title: On the floor of the House
hansard.roads: Raised the Kipsitet–Muhoroni–Chemelil–Mamboleo road and its spur roads.
hansard.education: Spoke on competency-based education, STEM and why young people are leaving farming.
hansard.tea: Raised payments to farmers in tea-growing areas.
hansard.dams: Contributed on dams and the Ministry of Water and Irrigation.
hansard.socialWork: Moved amendments to the social work Bill at committee stage.
hansard.fertiliser: Raised fertiliser inputs and the fertiliser budget for farmers.
hansard.settlement: Reported on a settlement-scheme visit as a member of the Environment committee.
